parameters.name: Report
parameters.description: Fields to report, in order (comma separated). Empty lists matching hostnames.

parameters.name: Hosts
parameters.description: Limit to these hosts. Empty = all hosts.

parameters.name: Tags
parameters.description: Hosts carrying any of these tags.

parameters.name: AllTags
parameters.description: Hosts carrying all of these tags.

parameters.name: Query
parameters.description: Expression to run, e.g. 'distro == debian and cpu_cores gt 1'. Empty lists all matching hosts.
